description: manni docs meta/set-up/new-required-field, run in a repo whose manni.config.yaml validates docs/ against schemas/doc.json. Two pages predate the new `owner` field.

steps.description: Step 1: add `owner` to the schema's properties and required.
Step 1: the run exits 1 and lists every doc missing `owner`.

runShell.stdio: /docs/api/errors\.md\s+\(root\)  must have required property 'owner'[\s\S]*docs/api/legacy\.md\s+\(root\)  must have required property 'owner'/
/Baseline written to \.manni-baseline\.json\s+2 findings recorded \(\+2 new, -0 no longer occur\)/

steps.description: Step 3: point the config at the baseline.
Step 3: green build, with the forgiven findings counted.

runShell.stdio: /legacy\.md  \(1 baselined\)[\s\S]*3 files checked, 3 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors\s+2 baselined findings/

steps.description: Step 4.1: a doc that lands without `owner` is not in the baseline.

runShell.command:
node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('docs/guides/new-page.md','---
type: guide
title: New page
---

# New page
')"

steps.description: Step 4.1: new violations fail immediately, naming only that file.

runShell.stdio: /docs/guides/new-page\.md\s+\(root\)  must have required property 'owner'[\s\S]*4 files checked, 3 passed, 1 failed/

steps.description: Step 4.2: the new page gets its owner, and someone adds the missing field to legacy.md.
Step 4.2: fixed violations are reported, not forgotten.

runShell.stdio: /2 baselined findings, 1 no longer occurs?\W+run --write-baseline to prune/

steps.description: Step 4.3: prune the entries that no longer apply.

runShell.stdio: /Baseline written to \.manni-baseline\.json\s+1 finding recorded \(\+0 new, -1 no longer occurs?\)/

steps.description: The one-statement ratchet: preview the ALTER first.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query --dry-run "ALTER TABLE docs ADD COLUMN reviewed TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'" docs/

steps.description: The ALTER adds `reviewed` as required and backfills every file.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni meta query "ALTER TABLE docs ADD COLUMN reviewed TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'" docs/

steps.description: Afterwards validate is green: no document is missing the field.
